scope.subject: The state of a reconciliation between a primary data source and an independent second source.
scope.note: This contract names and maps vocabularies. It changes no gate, no producer, no migration and no signed record. Every divergence found is registered under defects[] and left as it is; correcting one is a separate amendment with its own acceptance.

authoritative.producerOfRecord: Ashare-V6 src/data-runtime/contracts.js reconcileIndependentSources (emits the six values; RECONCILIATION_STATES is the code constant)

storedValues.meaning: Two independent, use-authorised sources compared and agree.
Two independent sources compared; the difference is inside the dataset-specific tolerance.
Two sources compared and disagree beyond tolerance, or their semantics/unit/adjustment differ. This is the only stored value that means the sources contradict each other.
Only the primary source is usable: the second is absent, pending, not use-authorised, or not independent. Single-source by construction or by outcome; it is not a disagreement.
Only the second source has data; the primary is missing.
Neither source has data. A positive finding (both were looked at), not an unread value.

readingSentinels.meaning: The reader has no usable reconciliation value (absent, null, or not in the stored set). Never written to a reconciliation column. When the field is absent a gate reports its reason code with the suffix UNKNOWN.

The question does not apply and a reason says so (for example source_basis SINGLE_SOURCE_BY_DESIGN or NOT_RECONCILED_BY_DESIGN). Never written to a reconciliation column; never a substitute for UNKNOWN or MISSING.

distinctStates.rule: No mapping may send one member to another member, and no two members may share a new value. A member that has a reconciliation-axis counterpart is translated to that counterpart, never to another member.

UNKNOWN.meaning: We cannot tell. Not a negative finding.

STALE.meaning: The datum is older than its approved maximum age. A stale PRIMARY_ONLY stays PRIMARY_ONLY on the reconciliation axis and STALE on the freshness axis.

ZERO.meaning: A present value equal to zero. Reconciling two zeros is CONSISTENT; zero against absent is PRIMARY_ONLY or SECONDARY_ONLY.

CONFLICT.axis: value / quality; local word of core_pool_evaluation and the compounder capability column
CONFLICT.reconciliationCounterpart: MAJOR_CONFLICT (never MINOR_DIFFERENCE, which is inside tolerance)

NOT_APPLICABLE.meaning: The question does not apply, with a reason code.

defects.summary: Seven archived signed records (core_pool_selection v1-v5, stock_book_five_stage v1-v2) admit [READY, DEGRADED], which are DATA_QUALITY words, over a reconciliation field. The gate rejects every row by construction.
defects.residual: five_stage v3 (effective 2026-10-10) and v4 (2026-10-15, open) admit [CONSISTENT, MINOR_DIFFERENCE, PRIMARY_ONLY]; the loader rejects any new record repeating the defect. No record in force uses the bad list. The 2026-10-09 60-to-0 rejection was five_stage v2.

defects.disposition: Ruling OQ-4: resolve by retiring the core_pool_selection record family in a separate small PR; the loader vocabulary is not changed for it. Core pools were retired 2026-10-09 and the archived records stay readable.
defects.summary: The loader guard checks a core_pool_selection gate list against RECONCILIATION_STATES, but the evaluated field is core_pool_evaluation.source_reconciliation_state, which only shares PRIMARY_ONLY with that set. A future core_pool_selection record could not legally admit MATCHED or SECONDARY_PENDING, and the values it may admit (CONSISTENT, MINOR_DIFFERENCE) are never held by the field.
defects.residual: No core_pool_selection record is in force after 2026-10-08.

defects.disposition: Ruling OQ-3: not touched by this contract. A separate revision candidate, to be opened after 2026-11-10 (migration 231 is signed text).
defects.summary: Three producers translate the same reconciliation state to a quality state differently, and one translates the other way. PRIMARY_ONLY becomes PARTIAL (quality.js), DEGRADED (financial-quality facts.js) or READY (migration 231, signed); position diagnosis maps quality DEGRADED to the reconciliation word PRIMARY_ONLY.
defects.residual: Changing migration 231 needs the Owner signature (an ELIGIBLE assessment may not cite a blocking input). Not touched here.

defects.summary: quality.js assessBatch indexes its translation table with sourceReconciliation.state without validating it. A state outside RECONCILIATION_STATES yields undefined and silently becomes UNKNOWN (secondary configured) or PARTIAL, whereas bindingDecisionForReconciliation throws RECONCILIATION_STATE_INVALID for the same input.

Nine reconciliation columns carry no CHECK: stock_type_score, feature_record, industry_membership, market_daily_basic_observation, market_index_daily_observation, macro_series_observation, fund_share_daily_observation, fund_nav_daily_observation, compounder_capability_observation. The database cannot stop a foreign value; only the list of writers (all hard-coded PRIMARY_ONLY today) does.
evidence: db/migrations (see columns[] where check is null)
defects.residual: Every current writer emits PRIMARY_ONLY or a code-checked value.

defects.summary: compounder_capability_observation.reconciliation_state holds CONSISTENT, CONFLICT, INCOMPLETE and NOT_APPLICABLE. CONSISTENT there means all four required facts are usable, not that two sources agreed; INCOMPLETE exists in no other vocabulary. Migration 128 requires CONSISTENT for a READY REINVESTMENT capability.
defects.residual: Research-only capability, capital binding is CHECK-pinned to false.

defects.summary: A recorded five-stage funnel (2026-10-08) carries SELECTION_REJECTED_SOURCE_RECONCILIATION:CONFLICT. CONFLICT is not in RECONCILIATION_STATES; it is legal only in core_pool_evaluation. No producer at HEAD writes it into stock_type_score (hard-coded PRIMARY_ONLY), so the origin is a pre-2026-10-10 path not reproducible from current code.

The same tokens mean different things across domains: MATCHED (two sources agree / reported sums agree / engine parity), CONFLICT (sources disagree / inputs contradict / sums differ), UNKNOWN and NOT_APPLICABLE (in six vocabularies), PRIMARY_ONLY (reconciliation outcome and behavior quality word). The contract resolves this by naming the domain, not by renaming a value.

defects.disposition: Ruling (coordinator, 2026-10-31): fix now, display words only, in a separate portfolio-desk PR with a test. :UNKNOWN is to read 数据源读数缺失，无法确认对账，先不进名单. The copies of this contract assert displayClasses on the baseline 50ab4e2; the fix PR asserts displayClassesAfterFix.

defects.summary: portfolio-desk shows SELECTION_REJECTED_SOURCE_RECONCILIATION:<state> through generic glossary words for four states and as a raw code for five. UNKNOWN renders as 两个数据源对不上，先不进名单（无法确认）: it says the sources disagree when the reader has no reconciliation reading at all, which is the conflation between UNKNOWN and CONFLICT this contract forbids, and it is reachable today whenever stockTypes carries no state. READY and DEGRADED (the archived v1/v2 reasons of 2026-10-09) render as 两个数据源对不上…（可用）, a contradiction. Only PRIMARY_ONLY has its own sentence. (NOT_APPLICABLE would render the same way; it is a reading sentinel and is never stored, so it cannot appear today.)
evidence: portfolio-desk src/panel/glossary.js (SELECTION_REJECTED_SOURCE_RECONCILIATION head; bare entries UNKNOWN, CONFLICT, READY, DEGRADED)
defects.residual: Display only; the gate and the record are unaffected. After the fix, READY and DEGRADED (archived 2026-10-09 reasons), CONFLICT (one 2026-10-08 record) and NOT_APPLICABLE (never stored) still read through the generic words; none is reachable under five_stage v3/v4.

rulings.ruling: MATCHED maps to CONSISTENT (two sources agree). There is no writer today; the test pins the mapping and a future writer follows it.
Accepted. UNKNOWN and NOT_APPLICABLE are reading sentinels only, never stored; the CHECKs of migrations 029 and 326 are not changed.
This contract does not touch RV-D3. It is registered as a separate revision candidate, to be opened after 2026-11-10 (migration 231 is a signed text).
